iconicAnchor.label: Precision watch movements documented as functional mechanical systems
iconicAnchor.creatorOrTradition: Horologists and museum collections of portable precision timekeepers
iconicAnchor.whyCanonical: The British Museum's technical record makes escapement, train, jeweling, regulation, finishing, and component relationships legible, anchoring the style in mechanism rather than luxury atmosphere alone.

sources.title: Paul Ditisheim deck watch
supports: A precision watch can be described through escapement, gear train, jeweling, balance, regulation, and detailed finish.
The component-level record supports macro imagery that shows functional relationships instead of decorative gears.

sources.title: Quarter-repeating watch movement
supports: The repeating mechanism demonstrates tightly fitted wheels, racks, pins, regulator parts, and engraved measurement scales.
Mechanical plausibility and legible function distinguish high-horology imagery from generic jewelry display.
